integrity: The unrestricted claims rest on a combinatorial classification and an analytic local-limit argument. Enumeration over finite stars is an independent computational cross-check, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Ambient-metric star-graph isometries only. No uniform error term in asymptotic results. Full text of some closely relevant primary works was inaccessible; priority beyond the inspected evidence is not certified.
title: Nilpotency profiles and a Gumbel law for star-graph partial isometries
